description: We are a team of enthusiastic B.Tech students interested in space, science, technology, and innovation. We enjoy programming, problem-solving, and learning new technologies. Our goal is to develop creative solutions to real-world challenges using NASA's open data. We are looking for passionate team members with skills in Python, coding, data analysis, research, creativity, and presentation.
summary: EarthWatch is a project focused on understanding and monitoring changes happening on our planet using NASA's open satellite data. Our goal is to explore environmental changes such as deforestation, climate change, land surface changes, and natural disasters. We aim to collect and analyze satellite data and present useful information through simple visualizations. This project can help people understand environmental problems and support better decision-making. We plan to use technology, data analysis, and creative problem-solving to develop an innovative solution. Our mission is to use space data to create a positive impact on Earth and contribute to a better future.
details: Our project, EarthWatch, aims to explore environmental changes using NASA's open satellite data. It focuses on identifying changes in forests, land surfaces, climate, and natural disasters. The project will collect satellite data and analyze it using Python. The results will be presented through graphs, charts, and simple visualizations so that users can easily understand environmental changes. We plan to use Python, data analysis techniques, visualization tools, and NASA open data. Our project is creative because it combines space technology with environmental awareness. It aims to help people understand environmental challenges and encourage better decisions for protecting Earth. The main goal is to make satellite information simple, useful, and accessible to everyone.
